Here’s a straight-up list of **reputed companies and platforms that offer free certificates** in Computer Science (CS) or related fields. These certificates are good for your **resume**, **LinkedIn profile**, and can help you stand out—especially if you’re a student or early in your CS journey.

---

### ✅ **Top Companies & Platforms Offering Free Certificates**

#### 1. **Google**
- **Course**: [Google Digital Garage](https://learndigital.withgoogle.com/digitalgarage)
- **Popular Certificate**: *Fundamentals of Digital Marketing*
- **Also try**: Google Cloud Skill Boosts (limited-time free offers)

#### 2. **Microsoft**
- **Platform**: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/)
- **Courses**: Azure, .NET, AI, Power Platform
- **Cert Path**: Some are free; pro certificates (like AZ-900) can be free through student offers or events

#### 3. **IBM**
- **Platform**: [Cognitive Class](https://cognitiveclass.ai/)
- **Courses**: Python, Data Science, AI, Blockchain
- **Certificate**: Free digital badges after completion

#### 4. **Meta (Facebook)**
- **Platform**: [Coursera (Audit Mode)](https://www.coursera.org/meta)
- **Courses**: Front-end dev, React, UI/UX
- **Tip**: Apply for financial aid or use free audit (no certificate), or look for free promo periods

#### 5. **AWS (Amazon Web Services)**
- **Platform**: [AWS Skill Builder](https://explore.skillbuilder.aws/learn)
- **Certificates**: Cloud Practitioner Essentials, ML Essentials
- **Free Cert**: Through events like AWS Educate or AWS Free Tier Learning

#### 6. **Infosys Springboard**
- **Platform**: [Springboard](https://infyspringboard.onwingspan.com)
- **Courses**: Programming, AI, Data Science, Cybersecurity
- **Certificates**: Free for students

#### 7. **Cisco Networking Academy**
- **Platform**: [NetAcad](https://www.netacad.com/)
- **Courses**: Networking, Python, CyberOps
- **Cert**: Industry-recognized for network basics and cybersecurity

#### 8. **NPTEL (by IITs & IISc, India)**
- **Platform**: [Swayam](https://swayam.gov.in/)
- **Courses**: Programming, Data Structures, DBMS, OS, ML
- **Cert**: Free to learn, ₹1000 for verified certificate after exam

#### 9. **Harvard University (CS50)**
- **Platform**: [edX](https://cs50.harvard.edu/x/)
- **Course**: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
- **Certificate**: Free if taken through [cs50.harvard.edu](https://cs50.harvard.edu/x/), or pay on edX

#### 10. **freeCodeCamp**
- **Website**: [freecodecamp.org](https://www.freecodecamp.org/)
- **Certificates**: Web Dev, JavaScript, Python, Machine Learning, DSA
- **Completely Free**: 300+ hours each certificate

---

### 📌 Other Useful Platforms Offering Free Certs

| Platform        | Good For                      | Notes |
|----------------|-------------------------------|-------|
| **Coursera**   | CS, AI, Data Science          | Use free audit mode / apply for financial aid |
| **edX**        | University-level courses       | Audit for free, pay for certs unless funded |
| **Kaggle**     | ML & Data Science              | No certs, but good reputation & competitions |
| **Scaler Topics** | DSA, Web Dev, Backend       | Good beginner & intermediate content |
| **HackerRank** | Coding + SQL skills            | Skill badges (not certs, but useful in resume) |
| **GFG**        | DSA & C++, Java, Python        | Some free courses, certs on premium |

---

### 🎯 Tips to Maximize Your Value
- **Pick 2–3 niche areas**: Like *Cloud + Backend* or *AI + Python*.
- **Post certs on LinkedIn with a quick summary of what you learned.**
- **Do mini-projects** to complement the certificates.
- **Use GitHub to show actual code** beyond just certificates.

---

Want a roadmap for combining some of these? I can help you create a **1–2 month certificate plan** based on your goal (placements, dev roles, etc.). Let me know.
